    30	__device__ __forceinline__ size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z,
    31	                                       const size_t nx, const size_t plane) noexcept {
    32	    return z * plane + y * nx + x;
    33	}
    34	
    35	__global__ void initializeConcentration(double* __restrict__ concentration, const size_t volume) {
    36	    const size_t first = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    37	    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
    38	
    39	    for (size_t linearId = first; linearId < volume; linearId += stride) {
    40	        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * size_t{1299709} % volume) /
    41	                              static_cast<double>(volume);
    42	        concentration[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
    43	    }
    44	}
    45	
    46	__device__ __forceinline__ double laplacian(const double* __restrict__ field,
    47	                                             const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
    48	                                             const size_t nz, const size_t plane,
    49	                                             const size_t x, const size_t y,
    50	                                             const size_t z, const size_t center) {
    51	    const size_t xp = x + static_cast<size_t>(x + 1 < nx);
    52	    const size_t yp = y + static_cast<size_t>(y + 1 < ny);
    53	    const size_t zp = z + static_cast<size_t>(z + 1 < nz);
    54	    const size_t xn = x - static_cast<size_t>(x != 0);
    55	    const size_t yn = y - static_cast<size_t>(y != 0);
    56	    const size_t zn = z - static_cast<size_t>(z != 0);
    57	
    58	    // dx, dy and dz are all one, so the three directional second derivatives
    59	    // reduce to this equivalent seven-point stencil.
    60	    return field[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, plane)] +
    61	           field[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, plane)] +
    62	           field[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, plane)] -
    63	           6.0 * field[center];
    64	}
    65	
    66	__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_X * BLOCK_Y * BLOCK_Z)
    67	void computeChemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
    68	                              double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
    69	                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    70	    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X + threadIdx.x;
    71	    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y + threadIdx.y;
    72	    const size_t z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z + threadIdx.z;
    73	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
    74	        return;
    75	    }
    76	
    77	    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
    78	    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, plane);
    79	    const double cv = concentration[index];
    80	    const double lap = laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, nz, plane, x, y, z, index);
    81	
    82	    constexpr double gamma = 0.5;
    83	    // With eAA=eBB=-2/9 and eAB=2/9, the bulk free-energy derivative
    84	    // simplifies exactly to c^3-c.
    85	    chemicalPotential[index] = cv * cv * cv - cv - gamma * lap;
    86	}
    87	
    88	__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_X * BLOCK_Y * BLOCK_Z)
    89	void cahnHilliardUpdate(double* __restrict__ newConcentration,
    90	                        const double* __restrict__ oldConcentration,
    91	                        const double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
    92	                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    93	    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X + threadIdx.x;
    94	    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y + threadIdx.y;
    95	    const size_t z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z + threadIdx.z;
    96	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
    97	        return;
    98	    }
    99	
   100	    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
   101	    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, plane);
   102	    constexpr double dtTimesD = 0.01;
   103	    newConcentration[index] =
   104	        oldConcentration[index] +
   105	        dtTimesD * laplacian(chemicalPotential, nx, ny, nz, plane, x, y, z, index);
   106	}

   119	        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   120	        return false;

   122	    return true;

   229	            computeChemicalPotential<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
   230	                deviceConcentration[input], deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny, nz);
   231	            cahnHilliardUpdate<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
   232	                deviceConcentration[output], deviceConcentration[input],
   233	                deviceChemicalPotential, nx, ny, nz);
   234	        }
   235	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   236	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph));
   237	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphInstantiate(&graphExecutable, graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0));
   238	        finalBuffer = iterations & 1;
   239	    }
   240	
   241	    cudaEvent_t start = nullptr;
   242	    cudaEvent_t stop = nullptr;
   243	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&start));
   244	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&stop));
   245	
   246	    std::printf("Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\n");
   247	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(start, stream));
   248	    if (iterations > 0) {
   249	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(graphExecutable, stream));
   250	    }
   251	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(stop, stream));
   252	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(stop));
   253	
   254	    float elapsedMilliseconds = 0.0F;
   255	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsedMilliseconds, start, stop));
   256	    std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", static_cast<double>(elapsedMilliseconds));
   257	
   258	    const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(gridSize) * iterations;
   259	    const double mcups = elapsedMilliseconds > 0.0F
   260	        ? cellUpdates / (static_cast<double>(elapsedMilliseconds) * 1000.0)
   261	        : 0.0;
   262	    std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   263	
   264	    std::vector<double> concentration;
   265	    if (printResults || validate) {
   266	        concentration.resize(gridSize);
   267	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(concentration.data(), deviceConcentration[finalBuffer], bytes,
   268	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));
   269	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
   270	    }
   271	
   272	    if (printResults) {
   273	        print_results(concentration, "Concentration");
   274	    }
   275	
   276	    bool valid = true;
   277	    if (validate) {
   278	        std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   279	        valid = validateResult(concentration);
   280	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   281	    }
   282	
   283	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(stop));
   284	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(start));
   285	    if (graphExecutable != nullptr) CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphExecDestroy(graphExecutable));
   286	    if (graph != nullptr) CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphDestroy(graph));
   287	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));

   290	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceConcentration[0]));
   291	    return valid ? 0 : 1;

+__device__ __forceinline__ double laplacian(const double* __restrict__ field,
+                                             const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                             const size_t nz, const size_t plane,
+                                             const size_t x, const size_t y,
+                                             const size_t z, const size_t center) {
+    const size_t xp = x + static_cast<size_t>(x + 1 < nx);
+    const size_t yp = y + static_cast<size_t>(y + 1 < ny);
+    const size_t zp = z + static_cast<size_t>(z + 1 < nz);
+    const size_t xn = x - static_cast<size_t>(x != 0);
+    const size_t yn = y - static_cast<size_t>(y != 0);
+    const size_t zn = z - static_cast<size_t>(z != 0);
+
+    // dx, dy and dz are all one, so the three directional second derivatives
+    // reduce to this equivalent seven-point stencil.
+    return field[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, plane)] +
+           field[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, plane)] +
+           field[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, plane)] -
+           6.0 * field[center];
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_X * BLOCK_Y * BLOCK_Z)
+void computeChemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                              double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, plane);
+    const double cv = concentration[index];
+    const double lap = laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, nz, plane, x, y, z, index);
+
+    constexpr double gamma = 0.5;
+    // With eAA=eBB=-2/9 and eAB=2/9, the bulk free-energy derivative
+    // simplifies exactly to c^3-c.
+    chemicalPotential[index] = cv * cv * cv - cv - gamma * lap;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ double laplacian(const double* __restrict__ field,
+                                             const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                             const size_t nz, const size_t plane,
+                                             const size_t x, const size_t y,
+                                             const size_t z, const size_t center) {
+    const size_t xp = x + static_cast<size_t>(x + 1 < nx);
+    const size_t yp = y + static_cast<size_t>(y + 1 < ny);
+    const size_t zp = z + static_cast<size_t>(z + 1 < nz);
+    const size_t xn = x - static_cast<size_t>(x != 0);
+    const size_t yn = y - static_cast<size_t>(y != 0);
+    const size_t zn = z - static_cast<size_t>(z != 0);
+
+    // dx, dy and dz are all one, so the three directional second derivatives
+    // reduce to this equivalent seven-point stencil.
+    return field[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, plane)] +
+           field[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, plane)] +
+           field[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, plane)] + field[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, plane)] -
+           6.0 * field[center];
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_X * BLOCK_Y * BLOCK_Z)
+void computeChemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ concentration,
+                              double* __restrict__ chemicalPotential,
+                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    const size_t index = idx3(x, y, z, nx, plane);
+    const double cv = concentration[index];
+    const double lap = laplacian(concentration, nx, ny, nz, plane, x, y, z, index);
+
+    constexpr double gamma = 0.5;
+    // With eAA=eBB=-2/9 and eAB=2/9, the bulk free-energy derivative
+    // simplifies exactly to c^3-c.
+    chemicalPotential[index] = cv * cv * cv - cv - gamma * lap;
 }
